stem: What proportion of children who present to the emergency department with abdominal pain will typically require hospitalisation?
explanation: 1/5 is the correct answer. Approximately 20% of children presenting to the emergency department with abdominal pain will require hospitalisation for pain relief, investigations, or surgery.

optionExplanations.A: Incorrect because 10% is lower than the approximately 20% of children with abdominal pain who require hospitalisation.
optionExplanations.B: Correct because approximately 20% of children presenting with abdominal pain require hospitalisation, which is equivalent to 1/5.
optionExplanations.C: Incorrect because 1/2 would mean 50% require hospitalisation, which is much higher than the figure given.
optionExplanations.D: Incorrect because 1/3 is about 33%, which is higher than the approximately 20% rate stated.
optionExplanations.E: Incorrect because 1/4 is 25%, which is slightly higher than the approximately 20% rate stated.

source.hint: Consider the percentage of the $20\%$ of all children who visit the emergency department for this issue.
